text:
Ana: Heads-up: opened PR 4991 to add language parity (Rust + Java) for the Optimize toolkit page covering batching, KV prefetch, and quant profiles. Small patch but a few nit fixes needed before merge.

Ben: Thanks Ana. Can you list the blockers?

Ana: 3 quick items: 1) broken anchor to console guide (currently /guides/opt/kv but should be /console/optimize/kv-prefetch), 2) Rust example includes an extra closing brace that breaks compile in docs preview, 3) we added a brief "when to use" note with a microbenchmark but need a citation or the exact bench command.

Ivy: I can do the anchor fix and add a short citation. Where did you run the microbench?

Ana: Ran locally using our `opt-bench` docker image on the shortseq corpus. Command in PR body:

```bash
# microbench short sequences
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/test-corpus:/corpus redwood/opt-bench:stable \
  --model redwood/llama-13b-4bit --input /corpus/shortseq-2k \
  --mode kv-prefetch --batch 6 --iters 250
```

Ana: Observed median p95 improvement ~3.8% and tail slightly better on repeated runs. Not a huge change but useful for shortseq workloads.

Theo: I'll take the Rust snippet. Which crate name did you pick?

Ana: `redwood_optimize_examples` to keep it obvious. Excerpt in PR: 

```rust
let client = Optimize::new(env!("REDWOOD_KEY"));
let req = Batch::builder().model("redwood/13b-q").batch_size(6).build();
let res = client.batch(req).await?;
println!("ok: {}", res.len());
```

Ana: There's an extra `}` at the end in the current commit that broke the docs runner.

Theo: Got it. Fixing and running `cargo check` now. Will also add a short note about the async runtime (tokio) requirement.

Ivy: Anchor fix pushed in commit 2. I also added a one-line reference to the microbench command and linked to the `test-corpus` repo. DocsBot will still complain about l10n frontmatter.

DocsBot: PR 4991 4: automerge blocked  missing i18n header in docs/en/optimize/kv-prefetch.md (l10n-check).

Ana: I missed that, adding frontmatter in commit 4 now.

Theo: Rust snippet fixed and tested locally (cargo check passes). Pushed commit 5 with the tokio note.

Ben: I ran the Java snippet quick compile. Need to change the sample import from `com.redwood.optimize` to `ai.redwood.optimize` to match SDK package changes in 0.10.x. I'll push a tiny tweak.

Ana: Thanks. Can someone do a final pass for wording around "when to use kv-prefetch"? I shortened it but want it not too prescriptive.

Ivy: Reworded that paragraph to: "KV prefetch is effective when requests have short prompt lengths and high cache locality; expect small latency improvements (low-single-digit % p95) and lower variance on repeated short-request traffic." Pushed commit 7.

DocsBot: l10n-checker: docs/en/optimize/kv-prefetch.md  frontmatter present, spell-check passed, pending translation-run.

Ben: All green from my side. Approving. :white_check_mark:

Theo: Approved and merged. :hammer_and_wrench:

Ana: Great. I'll add a short note in the release highlights and a link to the microbench command so readers can reproduce. Thanks for the quick turnaround, team. :rocket:
